scope: All original pytest node identities plus targeted test-owned retries. Complete-suite import and downstream retries may execute different source revisions; no same-checkout single all-green-run claim.

runs.scope: Full tests/ collection on the experimental checkout
Initial 22 failures and one skipped migration with corrected service configuration
Unmodified f02a6fb archive, separate empty PostgreSQL database, memory quality only
Remaining 20: external temp-directory permission and warmed Celery worker
Final directly measured 11-scenario memory benchmark after the test-double repair

observations: 18 AE6B queue cases required their explicitly isolated broker. A first repair exposed a Windows temporary-directory access error; resumed outside that filesystem restriction with the dedicated Redis logical database.

Two M3B tests require an externally running real Celery worker. The standard-environment retry's first ingestion took 27.516 seconds against the test's 20-second wait; the next task with resident weights took 0.532 seconds.
The citation-side connection-release timeout passed in the isolated retry. The hidden migration test passed against a new dedicated database matching its enforced naming contract.

The memory quality test failed identically on experimental and pristine baseline code. The production worker supplies before_provider_attempt and the old benchmark double did not accept that keyword. An isolated run after repairing only the benchmark double passed all 11 scenarios, including negative controls, with zero paid calls.
infrastructure: Separate test-only PostgreSQL and migration databases; AE6B and M3B brokers isolated from each other and from the live trial. Report excludes setup credentials, raw exceptions, model inputs and logs.
